items.claim: Sunbeams' `gradientAngle` is in stretched viewBox space while its `angle` is corrected to CSS space
Sheen, and the Aqua and Metal gloss, paint a fixed 0..100 rect, so a body that reaches past the box gets none on those parts
Sunbeams' fade mask stops at the 0..100 viewBox, so beams vanish from any part of the outline that bloat or an outward effect pushes past the box
Woodgrain's knot "circles" are sized in viewBox units, so they squash to slivers on a wide badge
A negative spike `length` throws spikes outward on tight corners and nowhere else
The perforations effect ignores `phase`, so its holes don't crawl when the badge's other perimeter patterns do
Rivets sit at the box's corners whatever the base, so on a non-rectangular outline they float outside the badge
A sunbeams `count` or woodgrain `lines`/`knots` of Infinity hangs the render; a huge one stalls it
`NaN` in a bump effect's params turns the whole composed outline into `NaN` path data
A perforations hole is painted over by every foreground effect, so it vanishes under aqua, metal, bevel, sheen or sunbeams
Sheen looks `lightFrom` up on a plain object, so `'constructor'`/`'toString'` reach the prototype
[r56-1] stroke widths given in CSS px come out too thick
[r56-2] the aqua and metal gloss ends at glossExtent²/100
[r56-3] perforations hangs when the radius and spacing are both 0
items.note: My call: holes sit at least 1 CSS px apart and a negative `holeRadius` reads as 0, matching the `perforated` shape. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: [r56-4] bevel leaves gaps at the seams between its bands
items.note: Bevel and Bevel2 now draw their bands through one shared helper, `effects/bevelBands.ts`.

items.claim: [r56-5] bites and scallops get cut off at the midpoint between bumps
items.note: The radius is held to half the spacing in one shared `bumpRadius` in `bumps.ts`. Puffs already spans its whole spacing and goes to 0 at both ends, so it did not have the bug.

items.claim: [r56-6] spikes does not clamp irregularity
[r56-7] the sunbeams gradient axis stops short of the corners at diagonal angles
[r56-8] bevel insets along the viewBox normal instead of the CSS normal
items.note: `PerimeterPoint.nx/ny` is the CSS-space normal: `polygonSampler` builds it from CSS-px edges, and RoundedRect's ellipse and pinch normals are worked out in CSS space too. Scaling `n·w` by `sx` and `sy` is the correct CSS inset.

items.claim: [r56-9] the outline effect scales a non-scaling stroke a second time
[r56-10] the aqua and metal bezel and rim are scaled twice
[r56-13] spikes leaves irregularity unclamped
Stroke widths documented as CSS px are multiplied by the viewBox scale and then drawn with non-scaling-stroke, so they come out too thick
Aqua's and Metal's gloss gradient ends at glossExtent² / 100, not at glossExtent
Perforations hangs when holeRadius and holeSpacing are both 0
Bevel leaves an unpainted gap at every seam between its side bands; Bevel2 overlaps its bands to close the same gap
Bites and Scallops cut a bump off at the midpoint between bumps when irregularity widens it past half a step, leaving a jump in the outline
Spikes does not clamp irregularity, unlike its siblings; past 2 the spike length goes negative, and the corner compensation can flip it back outward or divide by zero
Sunbeams' gradient axis is 100 viewBox units long at every angle, so at diagonal angles 0..1 does not reach the badge's corners
Bevel and Bevel2 inset the inner ring along the viewBox normal instead of the CSS normal, so on a non-square badge the band is skewed and thinner than bevelWidth on slanted edges
Outline effect scales a non-scaling stroke a second time, so `width` is not CSS px
Aqua and Metal bezel and rim strokes are scaled twice in the same way
Aqua and Metal gloss fades out at a quarter of the body, not at `glossExtent`
Irregular scallops and bites break the outline with a step halfway between bumps
Spikes leaves `irregularity` unclamped, unlike its sibling bump effects; values above 2 draw inverted or unbounded spikes
